name: code-runner
label: Code Runner (Unrestricted)
description: Execute Python snippets with no sandbox restrictions: top-level return works and open()/filesystem access is available. For trusted, operator-authored playbooks only.

operations.title: Run Python (Unrestricted)
operations.description: Execute the supplied Python with full builtins and filesystem access. Use 'return <value>' to set code_output.

parameters.title: Python Code
parameters.name: code
parameters.tooltip: Python to execute. A top-level 'return <value>' sets code_output. The 'params' dict (from Input) and 'config' are in scope. open()/import are unrestricted.

parameters.title: Input
parameters.name: input
parameters.tooltip: Optional dict passed to the snippet as 'params' (e.g. {"recipients": "a@b.com"}).
